paragraphs.text: Fiero Vespin was an art dealer in New Capenna , whose own schemes led to his demise.

Fiero Vespin was an ostentatious and out-of-place figure in New Capenna 's underworld. Despite being a member of the Maestros family, he was dismissed as a gaudy art dealer with no real taste or talent, embodying a superficial, flashy persona that lacked the depth or respect of his peers. His attempts to blend into the high society setting were marked by his gaudy fashion sense and ineptitude, making him a figure of disdain among those who took their roles seriously. His penchant for making an impression through flamboyance rather than substance caused friction and was seen as a cover for his deeper, more dangerous ambitions.

Fiero Vespin's actions revolved around attempting to establish himself within the family through disruptive and flamboyant tactics. He attempted to sabotage the high-profile wedding of Errant and Parnesse , which led Anhelo to be tasked with eliminating him to prevent further chaos. Despite his outward confidence, his ineptitude and the ensuing conflict revealed a lack of true understanding of the power dynamics at play, ultimately leading to his demise. Anhelo, though injured and strained, successfully orchestrated Fiero's death as a theatrical, symbolic execution to maintain the family's honor and prevent any further disturbances.
